Yes — clicking "Cooking" pulling up just my two cooking links, in one click, is exactly how I imagined it. And the structure feels right: the labels sitting in a row up top, each showing how many links it holds, and one link being able to carry more than one label — I can see my risotto guide counts under both Cooking and Ideas, which is just what I'd want.

One thing tied to this that I want to make sure of, since we've only browsed labels so far: I'd expect to be able to put these labels on a bookmark myself — when I save it or when I edit it — and, since I'll reuse the same ones, to have it suggest labels I've already used as I type, so I don't accidentally make a slightly different duplicate. As long as I can assign them that way, this labeling setup is what I want.
